The House Special Committee on Resource Management offers Bill 1063 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Thomas of the following substitute to HB 1063: 21st, Burns of the 159th, Cannon of the 172nd, Donatucci of the 105th, Hilton of the 48th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 1 of Chapter 3 of Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to generation and distribution of electricity generally, so as to require electric utilities … 46-3-83. Pursuant to the commission's jurisdictional authority under Code Section 46-2-20, the commission shall make determinations related to compliance with this Code section."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
